data.name: CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece
data.detailed_description:
Create It Your Way

CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece is a creative sculpting game where you shape colorful soft clay to match a given challenge.

Start with simple pieces of clay and use intuitive tools to push, pull, add, cut, smooth, and refine your creation. Paint it too — pick any color, then dial in how glossy, rough, or glowing the surface should be. There is no single perfect way to build it; your shape, proportions, colors, and details all come together to create something uniquely yours.

Clash With Friends

Create a room and take on up to three other sculptors. Everyone gets the same challenge and the same clock — then everyone's work is scored side by side.

A match runs over several rounds, and the challenges get harder as you go. Win the round, climb the standings, and settle it with a rematch. Between rounds, react to what everyone else made.

Prefer to work alone? Open a private room and sculpt at your own pace.

Speed Mode

Work fast and trust your instincts.

With only a short amount of time to finish, perfect proportions are not always possible — and that is part of the fun. Quick decisions can lead to unexpected, lopsided, and hilarious creations.

Finish your sculpture before time runs out and see how closely your result matches the challenge.

Master Mode

Slow down and focus on the details.

Master Mode gives you more time to sculpt carefully, build a piece out of separate parts, and paint the fine details. Rotate your work, inspect it from every angle, and keep improving it until you are satisfied.

Create something worthy of being called a masterpiece.

Shape, Submit, Compare

When your sculpture is complete, submit it and watch it take the stage. Your finished piece is scored on how closely it captures the challenge — its silhouette, its features, its pose, and its colors.

Every attempt turns out differently. Improve your score, try a new approach, or simply enjoy seeing what you create under different conditions.

Keep What You Make

Save your favorite creations to your collection and look back at them any time. Compare your best attempts at the same challenge and see how far you have come.

Soft Clay, Endless Possibilities

Turn basic shapes into animals, objects, characters, and unexpected creations.

Whether you are racing against the clock or carefully refining every detail, CLAY CLASH: Masterpiece is about the fun of making something with your own hands — and showing it to someone else.

data.short_description: Sculpt colorful clay against the clock — and against your friends. Everyone gets the same challenge; see whose creation comes closest. Rush it in Speed Mode for gloriously lopsided results, or perfect it in Master Mode.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
